blurb: Drawing inspiration from intense examination of the contemporary social landscape, Clint Brown’s exhibition A Life of Drawing, displays both Brown’s mastery of the medium and continuing relevance. Across a range of charcoal and conté drawings, Brown confronts pressing issues such as homelessness, environmental degradation, and epidemic disease, as well as universal constants of love and death.
